items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: This is a fragment from the desecrated and subsequently destroyed shrine to Beory.  The owner would be well advised not to display this too openly as heresy can often offend.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: This is a fragment from the desecrated and subsequently destroyed shrine to Boccob.  Someone people will go to any lengths to offend the Gods.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: A fragment of the destroyed shrine to Celestian.  That shrine is now lost to the histories of space and time.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The only salvagable remains of the shrine that was to Ehlonna.  Picked from the debris, this small stem was remarkably unbroken.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Fragment
items.Description: A crystal found atop the shrine to Erythnul.  At least it was before the shrine was turned into so much firewood.  Turns out the "gem" was little more than polished glass.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The only salvagable remains of the shrine that was to Farlanghn.  Picked from the debris, this boulder is all that remains of the once majestic statue bar rubble.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The only salvagable remains of the shrine that was to Heironeous.  Picked from the debris, this boulder is all that remains of the once majestic statue except for rubble.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The only salvagable remains of the shrine that was to Hextor.  Picked from the debris, this boulder is all that remains of the once majestic statue except for rubble.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: This is a fragment from the desecrated shrine to Incabulos.  If that did not offend the God of Plagues sufficently, then this fragment is testimony to the subsequent destruction of the shrine.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: This is a fragment from the desecrated and destroyed shrine to Istus.  A bane indeed for whoever did this to the Lord of all Fate and Destiny....

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The only salvagable remains of the shrine that was to Kord.  Picked from the debris this was the biggest fragment of what was once a sizeable statute.

items.Name: Desecrated Shrine Remains
items.Description: The remains of the desecrated shrine to Lendor.  There was nothing patient or tedious about its destruction, hence the large chunck of wood remaining intact.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: A fragment of the destroyed shrine to Nerull.  It is advised not to sell this to any passing Death Cults that you may meet.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The only salvagable remains of the shrine that was to Obad-Hai.  Picked from the debris this was the biggest fragment of what was once a sizeable altar.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: This is a fragment from the desecrated and destroyed shrine to Olidammara.  Well the deity is supposed to like a trick, but perhaps smashing up their shrine was taking the joke a little too far.....

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: A fragment of the desecrated altar of Pelor.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: This is a fragment from the desecrated and destroyed altar to Pholtus.  Even this fragment glows with an inner light.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: A solitary sextant was the only remaining unbroken piece of the defiled shrine to Procan.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The only salvagable remains of the shrine that was to Ralishaz.  Picked from the debris this was the biggest fragment of what was once a sizeable altar.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: A fragment of the destroyed shrine to Rao.  Looks like his follower's peace and serenity might be tested when they find out what happened to their shrine.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The only salvagable remains of the shrine that was to St. Cuthbert.  Stay away from the their followers, or you could be welcomed to a whole new world of cudgelling!

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The wreckage of the shrine to Tharizdun produced this single salvageable item.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The wreckage of the shrine to Trithereon produced this single salvageable item.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The wreckage of the shrine to Ulaa produced this single salvageable item.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The wreckage of the shrine to Wee Jas produced this single salvageable item.

items.Name: Ruined Shrine Piece
items.Description: The globe atop the shrine to Zilchus was the only fragment to remain untouched during the destruction of the shrine.  Persumably the desecrator could not reach that high.

items.Name: The Hedgehog Can Never Be Buggered At All, v.3
items.Description:
Old Noah was mucking the Ark out one day 
when he heard a great shriek from the neighboring stall. 
Said he to poor Ham, who was hugging his loins, 
"Ah, the hedgehog, my boy, can't be buggered at all." 

Chorus (repeat after each verse): 
Roll them all over and turn them around…

items.Name: The Hedgehog Can Never Be Buggered At All, v.2
items.Description:
1. 
You can bugger the bear, if you do it with care, 
in the winter, when he is asleep in his lair, 
Though I would not advise it in spring or in fall-- 
but the hedgehog can never be buggered at all. 

2. 
If you're feeling quite coarse, you can bugger the horse, 
or the palfre…
